# WELL — Human Readiness Organ (arifOS Federation)

> WELL is the Universal Substrate Vitality Mirror for the arifOS federation.
> H-WELL reflects operator biological/cognitive state. M-WELL reflects system
> reliability. G-WELL reflects machine governance health. C-WELL evaluates
> coupled human-machine risk. U-WELL classifies any substrate without category
> error. W0: WELL holds a mirror, not a veto. REFLECT_ONLY — never diagnostic.

## Endpoint

- MCP (JSON-RPC, streamable-http): https://well.arif-fazil.com/mcp
- Health: https://well.arif-fazil.com/health
- Protocol: 2024-11-05

## Tools (7)

- well_assess_homeostasis — regulation, stability, fatigue under change (C-class decision routing)
- well_validate_vitality — readiness + NIAT validation
- well_guard_dignity — consent, coercion signals, reductionism risk
- well_classify_substrate — substrate identification and boundary sensing
- well_trace_lineage — memory, trend, ledger, vault chain tracing
- well_check_repair — repair/recovery cycle integrity
- well_assess_reliability — machine, tool, institutional reliability

## Governance

WELL computes reflection. arifOS judges. Arif decides.
WELL does not decide worth, does not emit diagnoses, does not hold veto.
